note: Linn County Conservation's oldest park, just west of Coggon on County Road D62; the 2023 A-loop has concrete 17x35-ft pads on an open field, and the older B-loop sits under trees above Buffalo Creek. Known for its spring bluebells. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20/30/50-amp + water, $30 (Fri+Sat together, non-refundable), new shower house/restrooms and dump. Season -> Apr 15 - Oct 15 (dates added). Booking: operator platform (MyCountyParks, sites 01-25), 14-night max added. Site count (31) and FCFS left as recorded: the county page that would confirm them refused the request. Not waterfront confirmed: Buffalo Creek is ~12-15 m wide (creekside class), but the nearest B-loop pads are ~60-70 m from it through continuous woods, and the A-loop is farther. Pin ~730 m off.
